<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=44194 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=implemented_on_main confidence=high -->
Thanks for reporting the self-hosted setup ambiguity. This is now covered on current `main`; automated hermes-sweeper review verified the implementation and docs.

- `plugins/web/firecrawl/provider.py:123-139` accepts `FIRECRAWL_API_URL` without `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`; commit `363633e2b` explicitly added that URL-only self-hosted path.
- `website/docs/user-guide/features/web-search.md:101-108` documents `FIRECRAWL_API_URL` and states the API key is optional; `:206-220` documents `SEARXNG_URL` and the explicit `web.search_backend: searxng` selection.
- `plugins/web/searxng/provider.py:34-60` reads `SEARXNG_URL` for Hermes. The same guide distinguishes it from `SEARXNG_BASE_URL`, which belongs only to the SearXNG container configuration.
- The linked PRs #44218 and #44219 identified this same configuration/documentation concern. Current main contains a fuller maintained guide, shipped in `v2026.7.1` via `135f235165b`.
